brand.name: OLagoon
brand.description: Backyard pool manufacturer — drop-stitch inflatable pools, filtration systems, and accessories.

products.name: The Compact Plunge
products.summary: Compact 2 m × 1.5 m drop-stitch plunge pool with 20 cm rigid walls — big enough for two, small enough for any patio.
products.description: A 2 m × 1.5 m high-pressure drop-stitch inflatable plunge pool with 20 cm sit-on walls, engineered for cold-water recovery, hot-day soaking, and small patios or decks.

products.name: The Family Oasis
products.summary: Best-selling 3 m × 2 m family drop-stitch pool with sit-on walls, sand-filter compatibility, and a 15-minute setup.
products.description: A 3 m × 2 m high-pressure drop-stitch inflatable family pool with 20 cm rigid sit-on walls, a sand-filter pump port, and full-season UV-resistant fabric.

products.name: The Grand Lagoon
products.summary: Flagship 5 m × 2.5 m drop-stitch party pool with extra-thick walls, wooden-step compatibility, and space for the whole crew.
products.description: A 5 m × 2.5 m flagship high-pressure drop-stitch inflatable pool with reinforced 20 cm walls, dual filter ports, and accessory compatibility for wooden steps, canopies, and poolside furniture.

products.name: Sand Filter Pump System
products.summary: High-flow sand-filter pump kit that keeps OLagoon pool water clear all season with 6-way valve and hose fittings.
products.description: A complete sand-filter circulation system for OLagoon drop-stitch pools, including a 6-way control valve, strainer basket, and matched hose fittings.

products.name: Thermal Pool Cover
products.summary: Custom-fit thermal cover that locks in heat overnight and keeps leaves and debris out of your OLagoon pool.
products.description: A made-to-measure insulating thermal cover for OLagoon drop-stitch pools, cut to each model footprint with edge weights for a wind-resistant seal.

products.name: Protective Ground Mat
products.summary: Puncture-resistant ground cloth sized to each OLagoon pool, protecting the base from stones, roots, and rough surfaces.
products.description: A heavy-duty woven ground cloth cut to fit under each OLagoon pool model, providing puncture protection, thermal base insulation, and a clean surface for setup and pack-down.

products.name: Inflatable Entry Steps
products.summary: Drop-stitch inflatable steps that lock against the pool wall — a stable staircase for kids and a poolside seat for adults.
products.description: A drop-stitch inflatable entry-step system that docks against OLagoon pool walls, providing a rigid staircase with handrail loops for safe entry, plus a flat top that doubles as poolside seating.

technologies.title: Drop-Stitch Core Construction
technologies.summary: Thousands of internal polyester threads connect top and bottom layers, creating a rigid inflatable structure at 10-15 PSI.
technologies.description: Drop-stitch core is the foundational technology behind OLagoon inflatable pools. It provides rigid-body performance from an inflatable platform — straight, sit-on walls that hold pressure all season.

technologies.title: Military-Grade PVC Fabric
technologies.summary: Multi-layer laminated PVC fabric rated for full-season outdoor exposure, fusion-welded to eliminate delamination.
technologies.description: Military-grade PVC is the primary material used across OLagoon inflatable products. Multi-layer lamination provides UV resistance, abrasion resistance, and long-season durability.

technologies.title: Air Deck Floor System
technologies.summary: High-pressure inflatable drop-stitch floor providing a flat, rigid standing surface with reduced weight and setup time.
technologies.description: The air deck floor is a high-pressure inflatable drop-stitch system that forms a rigid, flat platform, reducing weight and setup time while providing excellent stiffness.

useCases.title: Small Backyard Plunge
useCases.summary: A compact rigid pool for tight spaces.
useCases.description: A couple with a small townhouse yard wants a real swimming pool for cooling off and relaxing after work, without permanent construction. The Compact Plunge fits a 2 m × 1.5 m footprint, sets up on any level surface, and pairs with the ground mat and thermal cover.

useCases.title: Family Backyard Fun
useCases.summary: A full-size pool for the whole family.
useCases.description: A family of four wants a pool the kids can actually swim and play in all summer, with clean water and easy entry for little ones. The Family Oasis offers a 3 m × 2 m swim area with rigid 20 cm drop-stitch walls, sand-filtered water, and safe entry steps.

useCases.title: Entertaining & Hosting
useCases.description: A homeowner who loves weekend gatherings wants a showpiece pool big enough for guests of all ages, plus reliable water care with zero fuss. The Grand Lagoon delivers a 5 m × 2.5 m swim zone engineered like a yacht deck, with filtration and thermal cover keeping the water party-ready.

articles.title: Drop-Stitch 2.0 — OLagoon Next Generation Core Material for Inflatable Pools
articles.excerpt: A new higher-density drop-stitch core increases pool wall rigidity by 25% while reducing weight by 10%, setting a new benchmark for inflatable pool performance.

articles.title: OLagoon Manufacturing Facility Achieves ISO 14001 Environmental Management Certification
articles.excerpt: The OLagoon production facility in Qingdao earns ISO 14001 certification for its environmental management systems and sustainable manufacturing processes.

articles.title: OLagoon to Exhibit at Miami International Boat Show 2026
articles.excerpt: OLagoon heads to the Miami International Boat Show with its full drop-stitch pool lineup and live fill-and-float demonstrations.

articles.title: OLagoon R&D Center — Forging the Future of Drop-Stitch Pool Engineering
articles.excerpt: OLagoon's state-of-the-art R&D center drives innovation in drop-stitch pool design, focusing on material science, structural engineering, and sustainability.

articles.title: OLagoon Strengthens Its Global Supply Chain for 2025
articles.excerpt: From German-made PVC formulations to vertically integrated production in Qingdao, OLagoon's 2025 supply chain upgrades cut lead times and secure capacity for 15,000 pools a year.

articles.title: OLagoon Launches Recycled PVC Initiative for Sustainable Pool Manufacturing
articles.excerpt: A new closed-loop recycling program repurposes production PVC waste into new drop-stitch pools, reducing landfill impact by an estimated 40%.

articles.excerpt: Turn Key Season Into Full-Year Business: Become an OLagoon Dealer Across the USA! We are actively seeking dynamic dealers to partner with our backyard pool brand.
